description: Returns the tenancy configuration flags for the authenticated tenant — notification preferences, overtime rules, payment basis, and other workspace-level settings. Internal admin-only TenancyFlag keys (GlobalOvertimeEnabled, EmployeePaymentBasis, etc.) are included. Use when the user asks 'what settings does my workspace have?', 'is overtime enabled?', 'what are my tenancy flags?'. Requires Admin or OwnerAdmin role. Read-only — this tool does NOT change any setting.
name: get_tenant_settings

settings.description: Array of TenancyFlag objects (flagName, dotKey, isEnabled, description, purpose, impact, selectionValue, modifiedOn)

title: Tenant Settings
